{"command": "git add test/discount.test.js && node --test test/ 2>&1 | tail -8 && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make codes case-insensitive

Add SPRING15 (15% off) to the CODES table in src/discount.js.

applyDiscount now upper-cases the code before lookup, so "spring15",
"Spring15" and "SPRING15" all resolve to the same rate. Previously only
the exact-case key matched, and any other casing silently applied no
discount. This also applies to the existing WELCOME10 and VIP20 codes.
Unknown codes still change nothing.

Tests added in test/discount.test.js:
- SPRING15 takes 15% off (200 -> 170)
- codes are case-insensitive ("spring15" -> 170)

No expiry date is enforced for SPRING15; the code is valid until it is
removed from CODES.

Sade dil (teknik olmayan biri için):
- Ne yapıldı: Ödeme sırasında yeni "SPRING15" kodu girilince sepet tutarından %15 indirim yapılıyor. Kod artık büyük/küçük harf fark etmiyor.
- Ne işe yarar: Bahar kampanyası kodu kullanılabilir. Müşteri kodu "spring15" diye küçük harfle yazsa bile indirim kaybolmuyor, böylece "kod çalışmıyor" şikayetleri azalıyor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Committed as `bfeef66`. Nothing was pushed.

My first test run used `node --test test/`, which treats the directory as a file and reported a failure. My `&&` chain still went on to commit. I re-ran with `node --test test/discount.test.js`, and all 4 tests pass.

- **What's in the commit:** `src/discount.js` (staged) and `test/discount.test.js`. The test file was modified but not staged, so I staged it to include the tests you mentioned.
- **Left out:** `scratch.log` is still untracked. It holds a note to ask Priya about expiry dates.
- **Message:** The subject is `feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make codes case-insensitive`. The body explains that your diff also upper-cases the code before lookup. That change affects `WELCOME10` and `VIP20` as well. The body lists the two new tests and notes that no expiry is enforced.
- **Plain-language section:** I added the Turkish "Sade dil" section your CLAUDE.md requires. I left out the "Otomasyon etkisi" line because this change doesn't reduce manual work.
- **Attribution:** The message ends with the `Co-Authored-By` line.
